title: Billing & Subscription | Capturebliss
lifetimePlan: You are on Capturebliss's Lifetime plan
lifetimePlanDesc: You can upgrade / downgrade Capturebliss directly from AppSumo
paymentUpdateInfo: If you have made a payment it might take couple of minutes to update the subscription information.
paymentFailInfo: If your payment fails, you will receive email regarding the reason of failure and the next steps. We allow couple of days before we cancel the subscription in case of payment failure.
invoiceInfo: Your invoice and transaction information will be emailed to you and will appear in this page soon.
queriesContact: In case of any queries reach out to
orUseChat: or use the in app chat.
trialExpiredUpgrade: Upgrade your account by choosing our paid plans.
downgradeWarning: If not, your account will be downgraded to our solo plan.
downgradeItem1: All existing demos will be locked & cannot be shared/ embedded.
downgradeItem2: Any shared/ embedded demo will be locked and cannot be viewed.
downgradeItem3: You can create only 1 demo with limited features.
downgradeItem4: All team members except the creator of the workspace will lose access.
downgradeItem5: You will lose access to advanced analytics & lead forms.
downgradeItem6: Webhooks and integrations cannot be used.
downgradeItem7: You cannot use our AI demo copilot & HTML editor.
contactSupport: For any questions, ping us via our in-app chat or email us at support@capturebliss.com
